public_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Count metric rows when sizing a pivot with metrics on rows**

For a pivot chart configured with `metricsLayout="ROWS"` and multiple metrics, each distinct row-dimension tuple produces a displayed row for each metric. This calculation counts only the dimension tuples, so a pivot with two regions and three metrics is sized as two rows rather than six. The resulting report can incorrectly accept a height that clips the content or flag a correctly sized component as excessively tall. Account for the metric layout and metric count when constructing the row count and labels, or explicitly skip this configuration.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

causal_evidence: 8613b8ca8780e83739107c202ef711c40f4d619b introduced the saved-dashboard sizing check, including pivot tables.
5343f3bb3263a27007557601c10376d630b11970 identifies the tuple-only count and records its correction. The supplied evidence lists that commit as both head_before and head_after.
evidences: The full commit message for 5343f3bb3263a27007557601c10376d630b11970 documents that two row-dimension tuples and three metrics were counted as two rows instead of six when metricsLayout is ROWS.
The supplied head is 5343f3bb3263a27007557601c10376d630b11970, the commit that records the pivot row-count fix.
payload.headline: Pivot sizing undercounted metric rows, already fixed at the supplied head
payload.before: The estimator counted distinct row-dimension tuples without accounting for the number of metrics displayed on rows.
payload.after: For metricsLayout=ROWS, the sizing check counts one displayed row per metric for each distinct row-dimension tuple.
payload.motivation: Undercounting rows can make the sizing report accept a component height that clips content.
payload.reply: The sizing check originally counted only row-dimension tuples. Commit 5343f3bb now counts one row per metric for each tuple when metrics are on rows, so two regions with three metrics count as six rows. That fix is already at the supplied head.
